dedupe_keys.name: ceacws r workflow for northwest atlantic marine threat layers

description: The inSileco ceacws repository and archived Zenodo release publish R code used to prepare Northwest Atlantic oil, vessel and offshore-infrastructure layers. The public GitHub root includes an R source directory, package metadata, an app entry point and a `_targets.R` processing workflow. A modeller can inspect or adapt its geospatial preparation steps when building comparable threat layers for port, offshore-energy or marine-response simulations. The code is a data-preparation workflow, not a marine traffic simulator or a model of spill dispersion. The README still contains generic project and citation placeholders, so setup and data dependencies are not fully documented on the landing page. The companion dataset is marked restricted by Zenodo despite an open-access claim, so this code cannot be assumed to reproduce its rasters with public inputs. No code was run and no archive was downloaded. The current Zenodo software DOI is marked v1.0.0 and states GPL-2.0; GitHub also reports GPL-2.0. A prior DOI with the same version label points to this newer record. The dataset's CC BY 4.0 licence is separate from the code licence.
